name: Tebar: share new blog posts from an RSS feed

parameters.content:
## RSS to social
Every hour, each new item in the feed becomes a post with its title and link. Items already in the feed when you activate are skipped.

**Setup**
1. Put your feed URL in **New item in feed**.
2. Open **Create post**, pick your Tebar credential and text-friendly accounts (Threads, X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Telegram, Discord). Instagram and TikTok need media, so they will fail here.
3. Activate the workflow.
